root_cause.incorrect_test_assumption: The driver assembled the bottom conductance from fixture-global disnod(numnod+1)=1.0 and separately asserted that this global value equalled 0.5*dz_last.
root_cause.actual_explicit_HeadCalc_semantics: headcalc grid_disnod(node) uses parameter_set%node_distance(node) for ordinary explicit nodes, but for node==numnod+1 it explicitly returns 0.5*parameter_set%dz(numnod).

scientific_effect.reason: The test-only companion Jacobian used the wrong lower-face conductance before the final geometry assertion stopped the case.

allowed_fix: Change only the test-only final-state Jacobian reconstruction so its bottom-face distance follows the already existing HeadCalc explicit geometry rule 0.5*dz_last, remove the invalid comparison to fixture-global disnod(n+1), and relock the runner to that driver. Do not change the frozen Gate-C plan, matrix, comparator values, factor 2, norms, numerical controls or production source.
